now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 55, Elena, an Inhuman whose bursts of speed snap her back to where she started, joins Daisy's Secret Warriors.

proposed.text: In episode 55, Elena, an Inhuman whose bursts of speed snap her back to where she started, helps Daisy's team storm a corrupt police station in Bogotá, then turns down an offer to join S.H.I.E.L.D. and stays in Colombia.

changes.evidence: In 'Bouncing Back' (S3E11, episode 55) Elena helps the team raid the Colombian police station, but when Joey asks her to join S.H.I.E.L.D. and the Secret Warriors she insists on staying in Colombia; Mack gives her a watch to call them. She first joins a Secret Warriors mission in 'The Team' (S3E17, episode 61), when S.H.I.E.L.D. picks her up in Bogotá.
